articles.summary: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. (NASDAQ: MIGI) (“Mawson” or “the Company”), a publicly traded digital infrastructure company, announced that it will be presenting at the 2024 Annual Gateway Conference, which is being held September 4-5 in San Francisco, CA.
articles.title: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. to Present at the 2024 Gateway Conference in San Francisco, CA

articles.summary: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. (NASDAQ: MIGI) ("Mawson" or “the Company"), a publicly traded digital infrastructure provider in the United States, today announced that it has entered into a binding AI/HPC (Artificial Intelligence/High-Performance Computing) colocation business agreement (the “Agreement”) with BE Global Development Limited ("customer" or "BE") to provide an initial 20 megawatts (MW) of digital infrastructure for AI/HPC colocation services at a fixed, pre-determined price for the first two years of the Agreement, and with an initial six-year contract term.
articles.title: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. Expands into AI and HPC Markets and Announces the Signing of AI/HPC Colocation Agreement for 20 MW

articles.title: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. to Join World Summit AI (Artificial Intelligence) in October 2024

articles.summary: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc.
